_comment: Public log. PRIVACY RULE: never name a reporter, quote their message, or include a Telegram id. Show that reports get fixed, not who reported them. status: fixed | in progress | planned | wont fix. ⚠ Only list PLANNED items you actually intend to build, and never put a DATE on one — a missed date on a public page is a promise broken in writing.

fixes.what: The free plan now gives 5 questions a day instead of 3, and one of them is always an image-based question with the real figure.

Added a safeguard against paying twice. If you already have access, or you opened a payment page in the last few minutes, the bot stops and tells you to check /myplan first rather than letting you pay again.
Corrected the checkout wording. It said access unlocks 'instantly'; it now says access unlocks automatically, usually within seconds and always within a few minutes, which is what actually happens.

The leaderboard now has three boards: most answered, best accuracy, and longest streak. The old single board ranked only by volume, which nobody on the free plan could ever top. Accuracy and streak are winnable by anyone.
Opening the bot now starts you on a real question straight away instead of showing a page of description first.

Added an optional daily reminder. Pick a time and get one short message a day, plus a summary of your week on Sundays. It is off unless you choose a time, it is never more than one message a day, and every reminder carries a one-tap Turn off button.
Added a shareable progress card — your questions answered, accuracy, streak and rank as a single image you can post. Get it with /mycard or from Progress.
Every question now shows which exam and year it came from, for example 'NEET-PG 2023'. Two older sets have no year recorded, so those show the exam alone rather than a guessed year.
Fixed 6 questions where OCR had duplicated one of the options, so the same choice appeared twice. The correct answer was never affected; the repeated option has been removed.
Reorganised the buttons under the message box. They are now grouped into Practice and My Account instead of one long list, so the menu takes up less of the screen while you are reading a question.
My Plan and Help can now be reached from the menu itself, under My Account. Previously you had to already know the command existed to check your own plan or find help.

Subscription payments were not unlocking access. A payment made through the auto-renew plan was not being linked back to the buyer's account, so access stayed locked. Fixed the same day; affected payment refunded in full and access granted.
Added /myplan so anyone can check their own plan, expiry and auto-renew status without asking.
Added UPI QR as a payment option alongside the card/UPI link.

Corrected OCR damage across 780+ questions: glued-together words, Roman numerals misread as lowercase letters (CN Vll to CN VII, Angiotensin ll to II), and stray source-book page references left inside explanations.
Removed one question whose patient age was clearly corrupted. It is out of rotation until it can be checked against the source.
Corrected the advertised question counts to match what the bot actually serves, and stated the number of image questions still held back.
Six questions carry a duplicated answer option. The correct answer is unaffected in every case; the duplicate distractor is being replaced.

planned.why: Right now the bot runs on my own laptop, so it can only answer while that machine is awake. Nothing is ever lost — messages queue and payments are picked up automatically — but you can be left waiting. A proper server ends that.
planned.when: Subscriptions cover the monthly server cost

planned.why: Access already unlocks by itself, usually in seconds. On a server with a fixed address the confirmation is immediate and never depends on my laptop being on.
planned.when: The move to always-on hosting is done

planned.why: 89 image-based questions are held back because I can't yet read the figure clearly enough to be certain of the answer. I would rather withhold a question than serve one I'm unsure of.
planned.when: Each figure has been re-read and checked by hand

planned.goal: The last of the OCR damage cleaned up
planned.why: A tail of run-together words still sits in some explanations. Nothing here affects an answer key — it is readability only — and it is being fixed by hand rather than by a script, because an automated fix on medical text does more harm than good.
planned.when: Ongoing — a batch at a time

planned.why: Both are already in the bank and both keep growing. FMGE is the deepest today; the aim is for all three to feel equally complete.
planned.when: Ongoing — questions are added every week

planned.why: Some topics are far clearer in motion than in a still image.
planned.when: Suitable material exists — if you have some, send it through /feedback

planned.goal: Other medical entrance and service exams, starting with UPSC CMS
planned.why: One place to practise whichever exam you are sitting, rather than a different app for each.
planned.when: The three current exams are where I want them
